liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **The Silver Cord**: rare: 13 archived performances [6]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Theia, Rats In The Sk [6]

## The recordings

- **kglw2024-08-20.mk4v.cmc1k.sx-r4.flac** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 16 songs; 120 min [1]
- **kglw2024-08-20.thor**: source not stated; 16 songs; 119 min [3]
- **kglw2024-08-20.akg.ck62.ck63.mixpre6ii**: source not stated; 16 songs; 119 min [4]
- **kglw2024-08-20.SBD**: soundboard; 16 songs; 120 min [2]

## Around the show

- Stu body surfs to the water during the Antarctica jam [1]
- Dedicated to Joey's high school friend Laura who moved to Portland, Maine [2]
- Joey stated the song should be in Happy Gilmore 2 [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2024-08-20.mk4v.cmc1k.sx-r4.flac**: taped by Ted Gakidis; transferred by Ted Gakidis; source: Schoeps mk4v/cmc1k(DIN,@sbd) > Sonosax sx-r4+(24/96) [1]. Also: Recorded with a Wave microphone into a MacBook Pro, then processed in Audacity [1]
- **kglw2024-08-20.thor**: taped by puffanug; transferred by puffanug; source: ADK Thor > PMD661 > 24/96 wav [3]. Also: Captured with an ADK Thor omni microphone positioned at FOH corners [3]
- **kglw2024-08-20.akg.ck62.ck63.mixpre6ii**: taped by Mark Davidson; transferred by Mark Davidson; source: Source 1 : AKG CK62 (NOS) > Nbob Cables > PFAS > V2 > Mixpre 6 ii @ 96 kHz 32 bit Source 2 : AKG CK63 (DINA) > Nbob Cables > PFAS > Mixpre 6 ii @ 96 kHz 32 bit [4]. Also: Two AKG CK62 and CK63 microphones fed into a Mixpre 6 ii [4]
- **kglw2024-08-20.SBD**: taped by Sam Joseph, Joe Santarpia, Grace Reader, Gaspard De Meulemeester; source: SBD [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Wear It Loud Tee: [Design King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard August 20, 2024 Thompson's Point, Portland, ME Poster Shirt, hoodie, sweater, ](https://wearitloudtee.com/product/design-king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-august-20-2024-thompsons-point-portland-me-poster-shirt/) [7]
- Poster by Jason Galea Standard Edition: [King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard setlist - 2024-08-20 Thompson's Point, Portland, ME, USA](https://kglw.net/setlists/king-gizzard-the-lizard-wizard-august-20-2024-thompsons-point-portland-me-usa.html) [8]
